text: The Administrator, Committees and Boards, City Clerk's Office, will give a presentation on Review of Meeting Processes and the Simplified Rules of Procedure which govern the meetings of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee, including related meeting matters, such as agenda timelines and supports provided to Committee Members by the City Clerk's Office.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the next meeting of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee.
